items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: There was a film clip, part of the Nicholas Brothers, a biography of the Nicholas Brothers that they show every once in a while on A&E, and there’s one of the things they did at the Hollywood Palace.

ctx.x: Let’s talk about live T.V. for a moment.

Oh yeah, well I was thinking about the Hollywood Palace. It was actually taped, but I mean whatever they call it, live on tape. Well the Palace in Hollywood, it was an old theater they kind of made over. And I didn’t realize it in those days, I guess I didn’t expect that much, because I’d go home and listen to the show, and oh yeah I can hear myself or whatever. There was a film clip, part of the Nicholas Brothers, a biography of the Nicholas Brothers that they show every once in a while on A&E, and there’s one…
Well things have come a long way. Technology and all that has come a long way.
